summary: Saved precedent changes now remain durable in downstream BF and DFM methods imported from ResQ.
details: BF and DFM refreshes align source CSV values to each method's canonical axes instead of requiring duplicate labels in precedent sidecars.
Review Needed BF methods no longer reload unrelated precedents during an ordinary Save or a single-source automatic refresh.
Dataset saves now warn when the source was committed but a downstream method refresh failed.
